name: Magic Theatre (1995)
notes: Knowledge Adventure, Windows 3.1. Source = the IBM 3-Pack CD (MTHEATRE folder + SUPPORT). The EU Packard Bell disc has no English. Replays what the CD's InstallShield SETUP.INS does for the Magic Theatre option, minus the IBM PS/1 launcher (PS1CDROM): the program comes out of MTCD.KAL (an InstallShield 3 library, every entry stored), WinG goes into SYSTEM, and MTHEATRE.INI [CONTROL] gets the five paths. The CD half (libraries, help, effects) is copied to C:\MTCD so no CD image is needed.
